test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer that question that follows.

The following bar graph shows the strength of employees (in lakhs) in a company during five different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6238925f4dbf87ec9e2cf4cdb03c876dd12ff12fc57301c2989a0566de033550.png] 

What was the percentage increase in employees in 2022 over 2019?
solution:
**Given:**

The percentage increase in employees in 2022 over 2019

**Solution:**

2019 = 20

2022 = 35

⇒ Percentage increase = {(35 - 20)/20}× 100 

⇒ 75%

**∴ The percentage increase in employees in 2022 over 2019 was 75%.**
